title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey Andy, it’s Anthony. Working on a story about the “new normal” for Tigers people - players, coaches, front office, broadcasters, etc. - can I give you a ring sometime today?
Nothing too in depth, just how things are different, communicating with players, etc.
Sure Anthoney anytime. Good to have you back
Thank you! Do you have any time tonight?
